assumptions: The developer is experienced with Spring Framework, Spring Cloud Stream, and Spring Cloud Deployer.

Documentation updates are limited to code comments, README, and relevant reference documentation.

All external dependencies (e.g., YARN, Redis) are already available in the test environment.

activities.activity_description: Design and implement a testing framework that allows module authors to wire and test configurations (@ConfigurationProperties), send data, and assert results using Hamcrest without an actual message bus. Includes mock binder, property validation, and Hamcrest matchers.

activities.activity_name: Implement U2 - YARN SPI and deployer
activities.activity_description: Investigate YARN distributed deployment, define YARN SPI, implement YARNModuleDeployer according to Spring Cloud Deployer SPI, and create necessary configuration and tests.

activities.activity_name: Implement U3 - Move trigger module from XD to s-c-s repo
activities.activity_description: Migrate the trigger module from Spring XD repository to Spring Cloud Stream repository, adapt build files, ensure compatibility, and run existing tests.

activities.activity_name: Implement U4 - Redis Sentinel cluster support
activities.activity_description: Extend the existing Redis binder to support Redis Sentinel cluster configuration. Implement connection failover, update configuration properties, and add integration tests.
Upgrade the receptor-client module to comply with the latest Receptor API changes. Update dependencies, refactor code, and verify existing functionality.

activities.activity_name: Implement U6 - Admin UI client configuration
activities.activity_description: Add appropriate server configuration properties to allow the existing admin UI client to work with spring-cloud-data admin. Test connectivity.

activities.activity_name: Implement U7 - Auto-configuration for singlenode binder
activities.activity_description: Create Spring Boot auto-configuration class for singlenode binder configuration/properties. Ensure conditions and tests are in place.

activities.activity_name: Implement U8 - Pass definition parameters to YARN container
activities.activity_description: Modify YARN deployer to propagate definition parameters into container environment. Update configuration and add tests.
Set up integrated test environment covering all user stories, execute end-to-end scenarios, detect and fix cross-story issues.
Update README, Javadoc, and reference documentation for all implemented features.
Review all code changes, ensure adherence to coding standards, provide feedback, and perform final quality checks.
